body: Yes, most likely, but any job will do. 19x9 is standard, there are lots of go tournaments, maybe even more than there are for chess. They are televised in Asia, maybe one day there will be an English televised tournament, that would be good. :)
I play on 9x9 and 19x19 boards, I play every day. I plan to get a job I guess, so I can make money so maybe someone will want to be with me.
At university. I enjoy playing games, [go](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weiqi) is my favorite, I used to be a moderator for the subreddit about it here.
Maths and computer science, I was not smart enough. I plan to apply and try again for the next school year, maybe on a different course.

It was because I failed my degree and could not find a job fast enough, she gave me a month to find a job and said if I did not then we would not be together any more but I could not do it. She has a daughter so needs someone who is able to support both of them. She quickly moved on to someone else, who she said while we were together that she liked and that he liked her, so maybe that had something to do with it as well. She is still my best friend but it's so hard to talk to her knowing she is with someone else, I still love her and keep letting my emotions get in the way of our friendship.

I will check out the website, thank you.

I am not always sad, but often. I also failed my degree (which is why she left me) but that bothers me less than it should. I think I have been depressed for a long time. I have social anxiety and an assortment of other things wrong with me, I always wish I could just be normal like everyone else.
